description: Two independent side-by-side timers for washer (35 min) and dryer (45 min) cycles, each with custom lengths and alarms.

faqs.a: Yes — the washer and dryer timers run completely independently, each with its own start, pause and reset.
faqs.q: Can both timers run at the same time?

faqs.a: Washer 35 / 45 / 60 minutes and dryer 45 / 60 / 90 minutes, plus any custom length from 1 to 300 minutes.
Keep this tab open with your volume on — each timer plays its own alarm when its cycle ends.

howto: Pick a preset or custom length for the washer.
Do the same for the dryer.
Start each timer as you load the machine.
Each timer alarms independently when done.
title: Laundry Timer
